description:
Use this to see what the dealer LISTS for ONE listing, as published: headline price, MSRP (new cars),
price_components, dealer fees (doc fee and others) and fee bundles (parts marked part_of_bundle, not double
counted), flags such as whether the advertised price already includes fees, options, incentives split into
all_buyer (already in the price) and conditional (not in the price), and the state's public tax and fee RULES
with data-flag checks. It takes no buyer inputs and computes no tax amounts or total.
Use estimate_out_the_door next for the buyer's total with tax, title, registration and fees, and
get_payment_estimate for a monthly payment. Pass conditional incentive label_raw values to those tools as
eligible_incentive_labels only if the shopper qualifies. A dealer-advertised monthly payment, when present, is a
price_components item of type payment_quote: dealer ad text, not a calculation. Each price_component has a plain
label, source_text and method_text; fees and incentives carry tax_treatment (taxable or reduces_taxable_amount,
whether it is inside the advertised price, and why).
name: get_price_breakdown
